---
id: cst-0001
kind: constraint
title: Spend over 500 requires asking first
state: active
created: "2026-08-20T00:00:00Z"
---
Spend above the ceiling requires asking first -- a model call is not a
decision, and this constraint exists so nobody has to keep re-deciding it.

```serenity:applies_when
action: spend_over
params: {amount: 500, currency: usd}
```
